args.code: (() => { try { const allSpans = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span, div, p')); const texts = allSpans.map(el => el.textContent).filter(t => t && t.trim().length > 0); const status = texts.filter(t => /春季|夏季|秋季|冬季|第.*天|💰|⚡|❤️|水稻|红薯/.test(t)); return JSON.stringify({statusTexts: status.slice(0, 15), totalTextElements: texts.length}); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({error: e.message}); } })()
